title: Realtek Wi-Fi firmware (rtw88)
summary: Lets Realtek 802.11ac Wi-Fi adapters (RTL8821C, RTL8822B, RTL8822C, USB and PCIe) connect.
description: The rtw88 driver is built into Phoenix; the adapter's own program (firmware) is Realtek's and is not open source, so it is not in the system image.
